messages:
sanjay: FYI — Meridion Dedicated outage follow-up thread. Cause summary: VPC peering flapped then on-prem firewall queued stale route => tenant isolation for ~2h. Need clear ownership + timeline for fixes and prevention. @maria @aj @samira please coordinate.

maria: Thanks — I’ll own the action tracker. I’ll split into network fixes, infra checks, and documentation. Tentative deadlines: network fixes by 2026-04-02, infra checklist update by 2026-04-05, doc + runbook by 2026-04-07. Sound ok?

aj: Quick note from logs: peering flap was triggered by a BGP hold-time mismatch; on-prem appliance re-learned a /24 late. I can push a config diff to the repo and a small patch to the BGP timers. Will need Samira to validate on their side before scheduling.

samira: I can validate. Could we get the appliance model and current config snapshot? Also, Meridion reported they have an older ASA image that drops graceful-restart state — that's probably why routes didn't repopulate. I recommend we add a compatibility check to the private-deploy onboarding checklist.

koo: +1 for checklist. I'll add a new gate in the private-deploy checklist: "verify onprem router supports graceful restart / BGP timers" with a linked test script. I'll aim to have the PR open by EOD 2026-03-29.

maria: Action items (owner → ETA):
- aj → push BGP timer patch PR with config diff + test instructions → 2026-03-30
- samira → validate patch on Meridion staging appliance (remote window) → 2026-03-31
- koo → update private-deploy onboarding checklist + automated test stub → 2026-03-29
- ops_team (maria) → reconcile incident timeline + customer comms draft → 2026-03-28
- infra (koo) → add a periodic peering health job for Dedicated tenants → 2026-04-12

aj: PR link: https://repo.redwood.internal/networking/merge/4821 (draft). Note: test harness shows the hold-time tweak reduces reconvergence from ~90s to ~12s in lab.

samira: I scheduled a validation window with Meridion for 2026-03-31 09:00-10:00 PDT. Will share results here. Also found an onprem firewall rule that blocked our management IP for ~15m during the event — that needs a follow-up with their infra lead.

sanjay: For the firewall rule, can we get a small runbook item: "when management plane unreachable, attempt alternate mgmt IPs and escalate to customer ops after 10m" ? Keeps containment steps clear.

maria: Added to actions: ops_runbook → short-circuit management fallback + escalation timeline → owner: samira, ETA: 2026-04-03.

koo: Heads-up: adding a synthetic check in monitoring that verifies BGP adjacency + route presence for each peering every 60s. If route missing >120s → page oncall + create incident draft. Will prototype Monday.

oncall-bot: Incident 2026-03-27-378 created: Meridion Dedicated VPC peering flap — follow-ups added to tracker. Link: https://incidents.redwood/2026/378

aj: small technical note for history: config snippet we changed in lab:
```
router bgp 64512
 bgp bestpath compare-routerid
 neighbor X.X.X.X timers 3 9
 no bgp graceful-restart
```
we're switching to timers 3/9 (hold/keepalive) and enabling graceful-restart where supported.

samira: Validation done — Meridion staging passed; route flap restored within 18s after timers change. Customer ops confirmed no disruption in staging. Proceeding to schedule prod change window with them next week.

maria: I'll consolidate and update the central remediation sheet after Samira posts the prod window. Great coordination everyone — assigning follow-up sync on 2026-04-01 15:00 PT to close outstanding items. :thumbsup:

sanjay: Thanks — please ping me if any blocker on the Meridion prod window. Once infra checks and checklist changes land, let's roll similar checks to other Dedicated tenants as a proactive sweep.

maria: Noted. Closing thread for now, will reopen if new issues surface.
